integrity.comparison_boundary: The 2008 congruence paper proves row equality and row vanishing but does not state the Catalan identification; the 2004 Catalan paper does not discuss hypersurface line counts.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to modulus three.
No statement about geometric line counts after reduction to characteristic three.
Residual originality risk from an unindexed short observation connecting the two known sequences.
title: A Catalan ternary law for line counts on critical hypersurfaces
